card.name: Word just before a number or amount
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a quantity is stated, mostly "recommended" after "The" in dosage sections. Also "should", "active", "average" and "to" when a number comes next.

modes.label: Recommended before dose
modes.description: The word "recommended" after "The" at the start of a dosage statement.
modes.example: 2.2 Recommended Dosage The<< recommended>> dosage is 100 mg once

modes.label: Other words before a quantity
modes.description: Words like "average", "active", "should" or "to" just before a number or amount is given.
modes.example: In the reign of Henry VIII. the<< average>> number of persons executed annually in England

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name in a combination-product strength line.

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of number words like hundred or fifty, so the quantity is not stated right away.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a dose or amount is given, such as "The recommended" before the dose.
